title: Anti-SAT block localization in a hardened locked netlist
description: Analyze a gate-level locked netlist and its locking description to identify key-gating structures and any key bit values that can be determined purely from netlist structure. Submit findings as a JSON report.
output_summary: A JSON report identifying key-gating gate/wire locations, per-key-bit structural findings (value, confidence, reasoning) for all declared key inputs, and a free-text topology summary describing how identified gating structures connect to the primary output.

metrics.name: key_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of key bits correctly and non-trivially recovered (limited to structurally recoverable bits) versus falsely claimed bits elsewhere.

metrics.name: key_gate_localization_accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of the hidden set of key-gating instance names correctly listed in key_gate_locations.

metrics.name: sat_iteration_reduction
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in SAT-attack iterations achievable given the reported structural findings, computed by evaluate.py from how much of the gating topology and constant-tied bits were correctly exposed (proxy score, not a live attack run).

metrics.name: false_positive_bit_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of non-recoverable key bits reported with value and confidence >0.5 without netlist-backed justification.
